name: code-tabs-mdx

frames.best_why: Both tab labels and the full install command are crisp and the cursor is out of the way.

tagline: Two install commands in tabs, with a copy icon on each line.
summary: A slim dark code card that shows a single install command under two tab labels, so a reader can switch between variants and copy the one they need.
appearance: A small dark grey rounded card with two tiny tab labels sitting along its top edge, one ringed by a thin outline. Below is one line of monospace text led by a faint dollar sign, with a small copy icon at the far right.
behaviour: Choosing a tab name changes the outlined label and replaces the command line underneath. The copy icon writes the command to the clipboard and turns into a tick for about a second.
demo_content: Two install snippets: npx ui-layouts add code-tabs-mdx and npx shadcn@latest add code-tabs-mdx.
search_phrases: install command with tabs for cli
code block with copy to clipboard
use_when: A setup step differs between tools and the reader needs to copy the matching command fast.
avoid_when: It expects exactly two code blocks; a single block falls back to a plain panel with no tabs.
customise: Commands come from the code blocks you nest inside; the two tab names and highlight colours are fixed in the source.
weight_why: Two short commands of pre-highlighted HTML and nothing that animates.

a11y.note: Tabs use the shared tabs primitive, so arrow keys work; the copy tick is visual only and is never announced.

issues: The recorded preview is a hand-written stand-in, not the real server-rendered component.
Copy confirmation is a silent icon swap with no live-region message.
polish_why: Clean but plain tabbed command card; tiny text floats in a lot of empty space.
